Perfect! I've successfully implemented the duplicate item endpoint. Here's what I did:

## Implementation Summary

**Added endpoint:** `POST /items/{id}/duplicate`

**Location:** `backend/app/api/routes/items.py` (lines 99-119)

**Functionality:**
- Accepts an item ID from the URL parameter
- Verifies the item exists (returns 404 if not)
- Checks permissions (only the owner or superuser can duplicate an item, returns 403 otherwise)
- Creates a new Item with:
  - Same `title` and `description` as the original
  - New unique `id` (auto-generated)
  - `owner_id` set to the current user (so the copy is owned by who requested it)
  - New `created_at` timestamp (auto-set by the model)
- Saves to database and returns the duplicated item as `ItemPublic`

**Tests added:** Three comprehensive tests in `backend/tests/api/routes/test_items.py`
- `test_duplicate_item`: Verifies successful duplication with correct fields
- `test_duplicate_item_not_found`: Verifies 404 when item doesn't exist
- `test_duplicate_item_not_enough_permissions`: Verifies 403 when user lacks permissions

All 14 tests pass (11 existing + 3 new). The implementation follows the same patterns as other endpoints in the file for consistency.
